sourceNote: The Texture Generators section of Simon Schreibt's Textures for VFX database (GDC). The programs themselves are not part of AstraForge: scripts/vfx/Install-VfxTools.ps1 downloads them from the official sites.

kinds.web-local: Web generators inside the studio (work offline)

tools.name: Material Maker 1.7
tools.author: RodZilla
tools.ru: Node-based procedural texture and material generator built on Godot: noise, masks, PBR, PNG export.

tools.name: FlowMap Painter 0.9.2
tools.author: TECK LEE TA
tools.ru: Brush painting of flow maps for water, smoke and magic streams.

tools.name: Pseudo Volume Generator 2.7
tools.author: Acetix
tools.ru: Generator of pseudo-volume 3D textures (slice sheets) for clouds and smoke.

download.note: itch.io serves the file only through the Download Now button, then No thanks, just take me to the downloads. Put 3D Volume Generator 2.7 Win.zip in downloads and run the install again.

tools.name: PixaFlux
tools.author: Diego Castano
tools.ru: Node-based image editor and texture builder: noise, masks, normals, PBR.

tools.name: KumoWorks 1.0.1
tools.author: OpenToonz
tools.ru: Generator of clouds, smoke and dust: renders volumetric clouds to images and sequences.

tools.name: Slate
tools.author: FacedownFX
tools.ru: Builds flipbooks and sprite sheets from sequences, with preview and flow texture preparation.

tools.name: Texture Generator Online
tools.author: Christian Petry
tools.ru: Procedural textures in the browser: noise, cells, wood, brick; saves PNG.

tools.name: NormalMap Online
tools.author: Christian Petry
tools.ru: Normal, displacement, AO and specular maps from any image right in the browser.

tools.name: Greeble / DisplacementX
tools.author: satelllte
tools.ru: Sci-fi greeble: procedural displacement maps made of rectangles and sprites.

tools.name: Neon Flames
tools.author: Jonas Wagner
tools.ru: Brush painting of neon flame tongues and glowing abstractions.

tools.name: Impact Decal (Material Maker)
tools.author: PavelOliva
tools.ru: Material Maker template: an impact and crater decal. Opens in Material Maker.

tools.name: Effect Texture Maker
tools.author: Mebiusbox Software
tools.ru: Online generator of effect textures: noise, flashes, explosions, rings; the result is CC0.

tools.name: Noise Generator
tools.author: Bubblebird Studio
tools.ru: Online generator of 2D/3D noise: Perlin, Voronoi, blue noise, normal maps.

tools.name: Flame Painter Online
tools.author: Escape Motions
tools.ru: Online brush painting of flames and fiery abstractions.

tools.name: Seamless Texture Generator (tgen.js)
tools.author: Tamas Schalk
tools.ru: Online demo of a seamless procedural texture generator.

tools.name: Fateloom VFX Texture Generator
tools.author: Fateloom
tools.ru: Online generator of clouds and noise for VFX. The site did not open on 2026-10-16.

tools.name: Free Seamless Textures Generator
tools.author: the orange box
tools.ru: Photoshop action: a seamless tile in one click. Downloaded after a free order.

tools.name: Smoke Trail Generator
tools.author: Gavin Finley
tools.ru: Substance Designer graph for smoke trails and dust. On Gumroad you can enter $0.

tools.name: Leaking Generator
tools.author: Martin Schmitter
tools.license: free; the Flipped Normals link returns 404
tools.ru: Streak and grime generator for Substance Designer. The product page no longer opens.

tools.name: Matrix Generator
tools.author: Martin Schmitter
tools.license: free; the Flipped Normals link returns 404
tools.ru: Generator of abstract matrix patterns for Substance Designer. The product page no longer opens.

tools.name: Splash Textures / Blender Generators
tools.author: Martin Schmitter
tools.license: paid; the Flipped Normals link returns 404
tools.ru: A set of splash textures and generators for Blender and Substance Designer.

tools.name: Substance Designer Quicktip Bundle V1
tools.author: Martin Schmitter
tools.license: paid; the Flipped Normals link returns 404
tools.ru: A set of Substance Designer graphs for noise and abstract textures.

tools.name: Substance Designer Spiderweb Generator
tools.author: Martin Schmitter
tools.ru: Cobweb generator for Substance Designer.

tools.name: Ice Pack
tools.author: Dete Art Resources
tools.ru: Ice textures and a Substance Designer graph.

tools.name: Substance Designer Tools
tools.author: Bruno Afonseca
tools.ru: Substance Designer graphs for caustics and cracks.

tools.name: Substance Node Pack
tools.author: Daniel Thiger
tools.ru: A set of Substance Designer nodes: cracks, stone, noise.

tools.name: Unreal Decal Designer
tools.author: RonanMahonArt
tools.ru: Generator of splash, liquid and blood decals inside Unreal Engine.

tools.name: Blood (Substance Designer)
tools.author: Bruno Afonseca
tools.ru: An 80.lv article on Substance Designer graphs for blood, splashes and streaks.

tools.name: World Machine for noise textures
tools.author: jqarlsson
tools.ru: Tutorial: noise textures for VFX from the World Machine terrain generator.

tools.name: Haze in Krita
tools.author: realtimevfx.com
tools.ru: A forum tip: thin haze and dust with Krita brushes.

tools.name: Cobweb from n-gons
tools.author: Cristobal Vila Laguarta
tools.ru: A short tip: a cobweb pattern from n-gons in Substance Designer.
